scripts.data:build: .venv/bin/python -I scripts/build_data.py && mapshaper data/interim/wahlkreise.geojson -simplify 10% keep-shapes -rename-layers wahlkreise -dissolve land copy-fields=land + name=laender -o target=* format=topojson quantization=100000 public/data/geo.topo.json
scripts.data: npm run data:fetch && npm run data:build && npm run data:layouts && npm run data:grid
scripts.data:grid: .venv/bin/python -I scripts/build_grid.py && mapshaper data/interim/gemeinden.geojson -simplify 2% keep-shapes -rename-layers gemeinden -o format=topojson quantization=20000 public/data/gemeinden.topo.json
